# RQ1.1: human vs. human/AI
```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 0. Load packages
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(lme4)
library(emmeans)
library(car)
library(performance)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 1. Read data (two sheets from the same file)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
human_raw <- read_excel("Dataset.xlsx", sheet = "accuracy_human")
agent_raw <- read_excel("Dataset.xlsx", sheet = "performance_agent")

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 2. Clean human data
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
human_df <- human_raw %>%
  rename(
    subject_id = student_id,
    score      = correct
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    group = tolower(group),
    group = factor(
      group,
      levels = c("cn", "ai", "sf", "ai+sf", "sf-ai", "ai-sf")
    ),
    phase = case_when(
      case %in% c(1, 2) ~ "Phase1_Baseline",
      case %in% c(3, 4) ~ "Phase2_PreInt",
      case %in% c(5, 6) ~ "Phase3_PostInt",
      case == 7         ~ "Phase4_Withdrawal"
    ),
    phase = factor(
      phase,
      levels = c(
        "Phase1_Baseline",
        "Phase2_PreInt",
        "Phase3_PostInt",
        "Phase4_Withdrawal"
      )
    ),
    case  = factor(case),
    score = as.integer(score)
  )

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 3. Clean Agent data
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
agent_df <- agent_raw %>%
  dplyr::select(Model, case, session_id, Accuracy) %>%
  rename(
    model   = Model,
    case    = case,
    session = session_id,
    score   = Accuracy
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    phase = case_when(
      case %in% c(1, 2) ~ "Phase1_Baseline",
      case %in% c(3, 4) ~ "Phase2_PreInt",
      case %in% c(5, 6) ~ "Phase3_PostInt",
      case == 7         ~ "Phase4_Withdrawal"
    ),
    phase = factor(
      phase,
      levels = c(
        "Phase1_Baseline",
        "Phase2_PreInt",
        "Phase3_PostInt",
        "Phase4_Withdrawal"
      )
    ),
    case  = factor(case),
    score = as.integer(score)
  )

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 4. Combine data (for Analysis 2: includes Agent, excludes CN)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
agent_combined <- agent_df %>%
  dplyr::select(phase, case, score) %>%
  mutate(
    subject_id = NA_character_,
    group      = "agent",
    source     = "agent"
  )

combined_df_no_cn <- human_df %>%
  dplyr::select(subject_id, group, phase, case, score) %>%
  mutate(source = "human") %>%
  filter(group != "cn") %>%
  bind_rows(agent_combined) %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(
      group,
      levels = c(
        "agent", "ai", "sf", "ai+sf", "sf-ai", "ai-sf"
      )
    )
  )

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 5. Descriptive statistics
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cat("========== Descriptives: Human groups × Phase accuracy ==========\n")

desc_human <- human_df %>%
  group_by(group, phase) %>%
  summarise(
    n    = n(),
    mean = round(mean(score, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    sd   = round(sd(score, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(desc_human, n = Inf)

cat("\n========== Descriptives: Agent × Phase accuracy ==========\n")

desc_agent <- agent_df %>%
  group_by(phase) %>%
  summarise(
    n    = n(),
    mean = round(mean(score, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    sd   = round(sd(score, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(desc_agent)

cat("\n========== Descriptives: Combined (human intervention groups + Agent) × Phase accuracy ==========\n")

desc_combined <- combined_df_no_cn %>%
  group_by(group, phase) %>%
  summarise(
    n    = n(),
    mean = round(mean(score, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    sd   = round(sd(score, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(desc_combined, n = Inf)


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Analysis 1: GLMM — Intervention groups vs CN group
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

model_df <- human_df %>%
  mutate(
    group = relevel(factor(group), ref = "cn"),
    phase = factor(
      phase,
      levels = c(
        "Phase1_Baseline",
        "Phase2_PreInt",
        "Phase3_PostInt",
        "Phase4_Withdrawal"
      )
    )
  )

# ── Step 1: Model comparison — decide whether to include (1 | case) ──
cat("\n========== Analysis 1: Model comparison — include (1|case)? ==========\n")

m1_with_case <- glmer(
  score ~ group * phase + (1 | subject_id) + (1 | case),
  data    = model_df,
  family  = binomial,
  control = glmerControl(
    optimizer = "bobyqa",
    optCtrl = list(maxfun = 1e5)
  )
)

m1_no_case <- glmer(
  score ~ group * phase + (1 | subject_id),
  data    = model_df,
  family  = binomial,
  control = glmerControl(
    optimizer = "bobyqa",
    optCtrl = list(maxfun = 1e5)
  )
)

cat("\n── Likelihood ratio test ──\n")
print(anova(m1_no_case, m1_with_case))

cat("\n── AIC comparison ──\n")
cat("AIC (no case)  :", round(AIC(m1_no_case), 3), "\n")
cat("AIC (with case):", round(AIC(m1_with_case), 3), "\n")
cat(
  "ΔAIC =",
  round(AIC(m1_no_case) - AIC(m1_with_case), 3),
  "\n"
)

cat("\n── Singular fit check ──\n")
cat("isSingular (with case):", isSingular(m1_with_case), "\n")

cat("\n── ICC ──\n")
print(icc(m1_with_case))

# ── Step 2：Final model ─────────────────────────────────────────
m_main <- m1_with_case

cat("\n========== Analysis 1: GLMM model summary ==========\n")
print(summary(m_main))

cat("\n========== Analysis 1: Type III ANOVA ==========\n")
print(Anova(m_main, type = "III"))

# ── Fixed-effect OR table
cat("\n========== Analysis 1: Fixed-effect OR table ==========\n")

fe_ci <- confint(
  m_main,
  method = "Wald",
  parm = "beta_"
)

fe_table <- cbind(
  OR       = exp(fixef(m_main)),
  CI_lower = exp(fe_ci[, 1]),
  CI_upper = exp(fe_ci[, 2])
) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  round(3)

print(fe_table)

# ── Marginal predicted probability table
cat("\n========== Analysis 1: Marginal predicted probabilities (group × phase) ==========\n")

emm_prob_1 <- emmeans(
  m_main,
  ~ group * phase,
  type = "response"
)

print(
  summary(
    emm_prob_1,
    infer = TRUE,
    adjust = "none"
  )
)


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Analysis 1 post-hoc comparisons:
# Each group vs CN (p-values adjusted separately within each Phase)
#
# p-values: BH-adjusted
# 95% CI: standard unadjusted pointwise CI
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

emm_vs_cn <- emmeans(
  m_main,
  ~ group | phase,
  type = "response"
)

contrast_vs_cn <- contrast(
  emm_vs_cn,
  method = "trt.vs.ctrl",
  ref = "cn"
)

# BH-adjusted p-values
contrast_vs_cn_test <- as.data.frame(
  summary(
    contrast_vs_cn,
    infer  = c(FALSE, TRUE),
    adjust = "BH"
  )
)

# Unadjusted pointwise 95% CI
contrast_vs_cn_ci <- as.data.frame(
  confint(
    contrast_vs_cn,
    level  = 0.95,
    adjust = "none"
  )
)

contrast_vs_cn_full <- contrast_vs_cn_test %>%
  dplyr::select(
    -any_of(c("asymp.LCL", "asymp.UCL", "lower.CL", "upper.CL"))
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    contrast_vs_cn_ci %>%
      dplyr::select(
        contrast,
        phase,
        any_of(c(
          "asymp.LCL",
          "asymp.UCL",
          "lower.CL",
          "upper.CL"
        ))
      ),
    by = c("contrast", "phase")
  )

cat("\n========== Analysis 1 post-hoc (each group vs CN) — Phase 1 Baseline ==========\n")
print(
  contrast_vs_cn_full %>%
    filter(phase == "Phase1_Baseline")
)

cat("\n========== Analysis 1 post-hoc (each group vs CN) — Phase 2 Pre-intervention ==========\n")
print(
  contrast_vs_cn_full %>%
    filter(phase == "Phase2_PreInt")
)

cat("\n========== Analysis 1 post-hoc (each group vs CN) — Phase 3 Post-intervention ==========\n")
print(
  contrast_vs_cn_full %>%
    filter(phase == "Phase3_PostInt")
)

cat("\n========== Analysis 1 post-hoc (each group vs CN) — Phase 4 Withdrawal ==========\n")
print(
  contrast_vs_cn_full %>%
    filter(phase == "Phase4_Withdrawal")
)


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Analysis 1 post-hoc comparisons:
# Pairwise comparisons among human groups (p-values adjusted separately within each Phase)
#
# p-values: BH-adjusted
# 95% CI: standard unadjusted pointwise CI
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

cat("\n========== Analysis 1 post-hoc: Pairwise comparisons among human groups ==========\n")

contrast_pairwise <- contrast(
  emm_vs_cn,
  method = "pairwise"
)

# BH-adjusted p-values
contrast_pairwise_test <- as.data.frame(
  summary(
    contrast_pairwise,
    infer  = c(FALSE, TRUE),
    adjust = "BH"
  )
)

# Unadjusted pointwise 95% CI
contrast_pairwise_ci <- as.data.frame(
  confint(
    contrast_pairwise,
    level  = 0.95,
    adjust = "none"
  )
)

contrast_pairwise_full <- contrast_pairwise_test %>%
  dplyr::select(
    -any_of(c("asymp.LCL", "asymp.UCL", "lower.CL", "upper.CL"))
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    contrast_pairwise_ci %>%
      dplyr::select(
        contrast,
        phase,
        any_of(c(
          "asymp.LCL",
          "asymp.UCL",
          "lower.CL",
          "upper.CL"
        ))
      ),
    by = c("contrast", "phase")
  )

cat("\n── Phase 1 Baseline ──\n")
print(
  contrast_pairwise_full %>%
    filter(phase == "Phase1_Baseline")
)

cat("\n── Phase 2 Pre-intervention ──\n")
print(
  contrast_pairwise_full %>%
    filter(phase == "Phase2_PreInt")
)

cat("\n── Phase 3 Post-intervention ──\n")
print(
  contrast_pairwise_full %>%
    filter(phase == "Phase3_PostInt")
)

cat("\n── Phase 4 Withdrawal ──\n")
print(
  contrast_pairwise_full %>%
    filter(phase == "Phase4_Withdrawal")
)


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Analysis 1 post-hoc comparisons:
# Each Phase vs Baseline within each group
#
# p-values: BH-adjusted (within each group)
# 95% CI: standard unadjusted pointwise CI
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

emm_vs_baseline <- emmeans(
  m_main,
  ~ phase | group,
  type = "response"
)

contrast_vs_baseline <- contrast(
  emm_vs_baseline,
  method = "trt.vs.ctrl",
  ref = "Phase1_Baseline"
)

# BH-adjusted p-values
contrast_vs_baseline_test <- as.data.frame(
  summary(
    contrast_vs_baseline,
    infer  = c(FALSE, TRUE),
    adjust = "BH"
  )
)

# Unadjusted pointwise 95% CI
contrast_vs_baseline_ci <- as.data.frame(
  confint(
    contrast_vs_baseline,
    level  = 0.95,
    adjust = "none"
  )
)

contrast_vs_baseline_full <- contrast_vs_baseline_test %>%
  dplyr::select(
    -any_of(c("asymp.LCL", "asymp.UCL", "lower.CL", "upper.CL"))
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    contrast_vs_baseline_ci %>%
      dplyr::select(
        contrast,
        group,
        any_of(c(
          "asymp.LCL",
          "asymp.UCL",
          "lower.CL",
          "upper.CL"
        ))
      ),
    by = c("contrast", "group")
  )

cat("\n========== Analysis 1 post-hoc (each Phase vs Baseline) — Phase 2 Pre-intervention ==========\n")
print(
  contrast_vs_baseline_full %>%
    filter(
      contrast == "Phase2_PreInt / Phase1_Baseline"
    )
)

cat("\n========== Analysis 1 post-hoc (each Phase vs Baseline) — Phase 3 Post-intervention ==========\n")
print(
  contrast_vs_baseline_full %>%
    filter(
      contrast == "Phase3_PostInt / Phase1_Baseline"
    )
)

cat("\n========== Analysis 1 post-hoc (each Phase vs Baseline) — Phase 4 Withdrawal ==========\n")
print(
  contrast_vs_baseline_full %>%
    filter(
      contrast == "Phase4_Withdrawal / Phase1_Baseline"
    )
)


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Analysis 2: GLMM — Intervention groups vs Agent group
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ── Step 1: Model comparison — decide whether to include (1 | case) ──
cat("\n========== Analysis 2: Model comparison — include (1|case)? ==========\n")


m2_with_case <- glmer(
  score ~ group * phase + (1 | case),
  data    = combined_df_no_cn,
  family  = binomial,
  control = glmerControl(
    optimizer = "bobyqa"
  )
)

m2_no_case <- glm(
  score ~ group * phase,
  data   = combined_df_no_cn,
  family = binomial
)

cat("\n── Likelihood ratio test ──\n")

ll_no_case   <- logLik(m2_no_case)
ll_with_case <- logLik(m2_with_case)

chisq_stat <- 2 * (
  as.numeric(ll_with_case) -
    as.numeric(ll_no_case)
)

df_diff <- attr(ll_with_case, "df") -
  attr(ll_no_case, "df")

p_value <- pchisq(
  chisq_stat,
  df = df_diff,
  lower.tail = FALSE
)

cat(
  "logLik (no case)  :",
  round(as.numeric(ll_no_case), 3),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "logLik (with case):",
  round(as.numeric(ll_with_case), 3),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Chisq =",
  round(chisq_stat, 3),
  " df =",
  df_diff,
  " p =",
  format.pval(p_value, digits = 3),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "AIC (no case)  :",
  round(AIC(m2_no_case), 3),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "AIC (with case):",
  round(AIC(m2_with_case), 3),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "ΔAIC =",
  round(AIC(m2_no_case) - AIC(m2_with_case), 3),
  "\n"
)

cat("\n── Singular fit check ──\n")
cat(
  "isSingular (with case):",
  isSingular(m2_with_case),
  "\n"
)

cat("\n── ICC ──\n")
print(icc(m2_with_case))

# ── Step 2: Final model ──────────────────────────────────────
fit_global <- m2_with_case

cat("\n========== Analysis 2: GLMM model summary ==========\n")
print(summary(fit_global))

cat("\n========== Analysis 2: Type III ANOVA ==========\n")
print(Anova(fit_global, type = "III"))

# ── Fixed-effect OR table
cat("\n========== Analysis 2: Fixed-effect OR table ==========\n")

glm_ci <- confint(
  fit_global,
  method = "Wald",
  parm = "beta_"
)

glm_or_table <- cbind(
  OR       = exp(fixef(fit_global)),
  CI_lower = exp(glm_ci[, 1]),
  CI_upper = exp(glm_ci[, 2])
) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  round(3)

print(glm_or_table)

# ── Marginal predicted probability table
cat("\n========== Analysis 2: Marginal predicted probabilities (group × phase) ==========\n")

emm_prob_2 <- emmeans(
  fit_global,
  ~ group * phase,
  type = "response"
)

print(
  summary(
    emm_prob_2,
    infer = TRUE,
    adjust = "none"
  )
)


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Analysis 2 post-hoc comparisons:
# Each group vs Agent (p-values adjusted separately within each Phase)
#
# p-values: BH-adjusted
# 95% CI: standard unadjusted pointwise CI
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

emm_vs_agent <- emmeans(
  fit_global,
  ~ group | phase,
  type = "response"
)

contrast_vs_agent <- contrast(
  emm_vs_agent,
  method = "trt.vs.ctrl",
  ref = "agent"
)

# BH-adjusted p-values
contrast_vs_agent_test <- as.data.frame(
  summary(
    contrast_vs_agent,
    infer  = c(FALSE, TRUE),
    adjust = "BH"
  )
)

# Unadjusted pointwise 95% CI
contrast_vs_agent_ci <- as.data.frame(
  confint(
    contrast_vs_agent,
    level  = 0.95,
    adjust = "none"
  )
)

contrast_vs_agent_full <- contrast_vs_agent_test %>%
  dplyr::select(
    -any_of(c("asymp.LCL", "asymp.UCL", "lower.CL", "upper.CL"))
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    contrast_vs_agent_ci %>%
      dplyr::select(
        contrast,
        phase,
        any_of(c(
          "asymp.LCL",
          "asymp.UCL",
          "lower.CL",
          "upper.CL"
        ))
      ),
    by = c("contrast", "phase")
  )

cat("\n========== Analysis 2 post-hoc (each group vs Agent) — Phase 1 Baseline ==========\n")
print(
  contrast_vs_agent_full %>%
    filter(phase == "Phase1_Baseline")
)

cat("\n========== Analysis 2 post-hoc (each group vs Agent) — Phase 2 Pre-intervention ==========\n")
print(
  contrast_vs_agent_full %>%
    filter(phase == "Phase2_PreInt")
)

cat("\n========== Analysis 2 post-hoc (each group vs Agent) — Phase 3 Post-intervention ==========\n")
print(
  contrast_vs_agent_full %>%
    filter(phase == "Phase3_PostInt")
)

cat("\n========== Analysis 2 post-hoc (each group vs Agent) — Phase 4 Withdrawal ==========\n")
print(
  contrast_vs_agent_full %>%
    filter(phase == "Phase4_Withdrawal")
)


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Analysis 2 post-hoc comparisons:
# Each Phase vs Baseline within each group
#
# p-values: BH-adjusted (within each group)
# 95% CI: standard unadjusted pointwise CI
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

emm_vs_baseline2 <- emmeans(
  fit_global,
  ~ phase | group,
  type = "response"
)

contrast_vs_baseline2 <- contrast(
  emm_vs_baseline2,
  method = "trt.vs.ctrl",
  ref = "Phase1_Baseline"
)

# BH-adjusted p-values
contrast_vs_baseline2_test <- as.data.frame(
  summary(
    contrast_vs_baseline2,
    infer  = c(FALSE, TRUE),
    adjust = "BH"
  )
)

# Unadjusted pointwise 95% CI
contrast_vs_baseline2_ci <- as.data.frame(
  confint(
    contrast_vs_baseline2,
    level  = 0.95,
    adjust = "none"
  )
)

contrast_vs_baseline2_full <- contrast_vs_baseline2_test %>%
  dplyr::select(
    -any_of(c("asymp.LCL", "asymp.UCL", "lower.CL", "upper.CL"))
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    contrast_vs_baseline2_ci %>%
      dplyr::select(
        contrast,
        group,
        any_of(c(
          "asymp.LCL",
          "asymp.UCL",
          "lower.CL",
          "upper.CL"
        ))
      ),
    by = c("contrast", "group")
  )

cat("\n========== Analysis 2 post-hoc (each Phase vs Baseline) — Phase 2 Pre-intervention ==========\n")
print(
  contrast_vs_baseline2_full %>%
    filter(
      contrast == "Phase2_PreInt / Phase1_Baseline"
    )
)

cat("\n========== Analysis 2 post-hoc (each Phase vs Baseline) — Phase 3 Post-intervention ==========\n")
print(
  contrast_vs_baseline2_full %>%
    filter(
      contrast == "Phase3_PostInt / Phase1_Baseline"
    )
)

cat("\n========== Analysis 2 post-hoc (each Phase vs Baseline) — Phase 4 Withdrawal ==========\n")
print(
  contrast_vs_baseline2_full %>%
    filter(
      contrast == "Phase4_Withdrawal / Phase1_Baseline"
    )
)

```


# RQ1.2: SF vs. noSF
```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# "Initial Protected-Scaffolding" vs "Initial Direct-Answer Availability"
#
# SF-led:
#   sf      = +1/2
#   sf-ai   = +1/2
#
# noSF-led:
#   ai      = -1/3
#   ai+sf   = -1/3
#   ai-sf   = -1/3
#
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ── Step 1: Extract EMMs for each group within each phase ─────
emm_group_phase <- emmeans(m_main, ~ group | phase, type = "response")

# Confirm group order (the weight vector must match this order)
cat("── Group order check ──\n")
print(as.data.frame(emm_group_phase)[, c("group", "phase")] %>%
  filter(phase == "Phase1_Baseline"))

# ── Step 2: Define contrast weights ───────────────────────────
# Group order (from levels): cn, ai, sf, ai+sf, sf-ai, ai-sf
# Corresponding weights:      0, -1/3, +1/2, -1/3, +1/2, -1/3

protected_sf_contrast <- list(
  "Protected-Scaffolding vs Direct-Answer" = c(
     0,      # cn
    -1/3,    # ai
     1/2,    # sf
    -1/3,    # ai+sf
     1/2,    # sf-ai
    -1/3     # ai-sf
  )
)

# ── Step 3: Extract the contrast for each phase; BH correction (4 tests) ──
contrast_ps_raw <- contrast(
  emm_group_phase,
  method = protected_sf_contrast,
  adjust = "none"
)

contrast_ps_df <- as.data.frame(summary(contrast_ps_raw, infer = TRUE))
contrast_ps_df$p.value.BH <- p.adjust(contrast_ps_df$p.value, method = "BH")

ci_cols <- grep("LCL|UCL", names(contrast_ps_df), value = TRUE)

cat("\n========== Initial Protected-Scaffolding Contrast (BH-corrected, 4 tests) ==========\n")
cat("OR > 1: SF-led groups perform significantly better than noSF-led groups\n\n")
print(contrast_ps_df %>%
  dplyr::select(phase, contrast, odds.ratio, SE,
                all_of(ci_cols), z.ratio, p.value, p.value.BH))

# ── Step 4: Significance labels ───────────────────────────────
fmt_sig <- function(p) dplyr::case_when(
  p < .001 ~ "***",
  p < .01  ~ "**",
  p < .05  ~ "*",
  TRUE     ~ "ns"
)

cat("\n── Significance summary ──\n")
print(contrast_ps_df %>%
  mutate(
    p.value    = round(p.value, 4),
    p.value.BH = round(p.value.BH, 4),
    sig        = fmt_sig(p.value.BH)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(phase, odds.ratio, p.value, p.value.BH, sig))
```

# Export the table
```{r}

# A2

saveWorkbook(wb, "GLMM_results_P1-P4.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)
```

# Draw pictures
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(forcats)
library(patchwork)
library(showtext)
library(cowplot)
library(ggh4x)

font_add(
  family     = "Arial",
  regular    = "/Library/Fonts/Arial.ttf",
  bold       = "/Library/Fonts/Arial Bold.ttf",
  italic     = "/Library/Fonts/Arial Italic.ttf",
  bolditalic = "/Library/Fonts/Arial Bold Italic.ttf"
)
showtext_auto()
showtext_opts(dpi = 600)

extract_contrast_df <- function(contrast_obj, ref_name) {

  s <- as.data.frame(
    summary(contrast_obj, infer = c(FALSE, TRUE), adjust = "BH")
  )
  
  ci <- as.data.frame(
    confint(contrast_obj, level = 0.95, adjust = "none")
  )

  df <- data.frame(
    contrast  = s$contrast,
    phase     = s$phase,
    OR        = s$odds.ratio,
    z         = s$z.ratio,
    p         = s$p.value,        
    CI_lower  = ci$asymp.LCL,
    CI_upper  = ci$asymp.UCL
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      sig = case_when(
        p < .001 ~ "***",
        p < .01  ~ "**",
        p < .05  ~ "*",
        TRUE     ~ ""
      ),
      significant = p < .05,
      group_label = gsub(paste0(" / ", ref_name), "", contrast),
      group_label = gsub("[()]", "", group_label),
      group_label = trimws(group_label),
      group_label = factor(group_label,
                           levels = c("ai", "sf", "sf-ai", "ai-sf", "ai+sf"))
    ) %>%
    filter(phase != "Phase5_Tool")

  message(sprintf("[extract] ref=%s, total rows=%d, groups=%s",
                  ref_name, nrow(df),
                  paste(levels(droplevels(df$group_label)), collapse = ", ")))
  return(df)
}


df_cn    <- extract_contrast_df(contrast_vs_cn,    ref_name = "cn")
df_agent <- extract_contrast_df(contrast_vs_agent, ref_name = "agent")


group_colors <- c(
  "ai"    = "#AA2B46",
  "sf"    = "#6CB3DA",
  "sf-ai" = "#3B5DA3",
  "ai-sf" = "#E58760",
  "ai+sf" = "#F6DEA4"
)


group_labels <- c(
  "ai"    = "ASST",
  "sf"    = "SF",
  "sf-ai" = "SF-ASST",
  "ai-sf" = "ASST-SF",
  "ai+sf" = "SF+ASST"
)


phase_labels <- c(
  "Phase1_Baseline"   = "P1: AI-free\nBaseline",
  "Phase2_PreInt"     = "P2: Initial\nIntervention",
  "Phase3_PostInt"    = "P3: Subsequent\nIntervention",
  "Phase4_Withdrawal" = "P4: Support\nWithdrawal"
)


phase_strip_fills <- list(
  element_rect(fill = "#D6D6D6", color = NA),
  element_rect(fill = "#BDD7EE", color = NA),
  element_rect(fill = "#BDD7EE", color = NA),
  element_rect(fill = "#C5E0B4", color = NA)
)


group_order <- c("ai", "sf", "sf-ai", "ai-sf", "ai+sf")

df_cn$phase_label    <- factor(phase_labels[df_cn$phase],    levels = phase_labels)
df_agent$phase_label <- factor(phase_labels[df_agent$phase], levels = phase_labels)

df_cn    <- df_cn    %>% mutate(group_label = factor(group_label, levels = group_order))
df_agent <- df_agent %>% mutate(group_label = factor(group_label, levels = group_order))


plot_forest <- function(df) {
  base_pt   <- 8
  cap_value <- 500

  df <- df %>% mutate(
    CI_upper_plot = pmin(CI_upper, cap_value),
    arrow_right   = CI_upper > cap_value,
    group_display = factor(
      group_labels[as.character(group_label)],
      levels = unname(group_labels[group_order])
    )
  )
  df_sig <- filter(df, significant)

  ggplot(df, aes(x = OR, y = fct_rev(group_display), color = group_label)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed",
               color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_errorbarh(
      aes(xmin = CI_lower, xmax = CI_upper_plot, alpha = significant),
      height = 0.3, linewidth = 1.0
    ) +
    scale_alpha_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 1.0, "FALSE" = 0.15)) +
    geom_segment(
      data = filter(df, arrow_right),
      aes(x = CI_upper_plot, xend = CI_upper_plot * 1.06,
          y = fct_rev(group_display), yend = fct_rev(group_display)),
      arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.12, "cm"), type = "closed"),
      linewidth = 1.0, inherit.aes = TRUE
    ) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = significant, size = significant, alpha = significant)) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 18, "FALSE" = 16)) +
    scale_size_manual(values  = c("TRUE" = 3.0, "FALSE" = 2.0)) +
    geom_text(
      data = df_sig,
      aes(x = OR, y = fct_rev(group_display), label = sig, color = group_label),
      hjust = -0.3, vjust = 0.4,
      size  = 4.5 / .pt * 2.5, family = "Arial",
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = group_colors, labels = group_labels) +
    facet_grid2(
      . ~ phase_label,
      scales = "free_x",
      strip  = strip_themed(background_x = phase_strip_fills)
    ) +
    scale_x_log10(
      breaks = c(0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 5, 10, 50, 200),
      labels = c("0.1", "0.25", "0.5", "1", "2", "5", "10", "50", "200")
    ) +
    labs(x = "Odds Ratio (log scale)", y = NULL) +
    guides(color = "none", shape = "none", size = "none", alpha = "none") +
    theme_classic(base_size = base_pt, base_family = "Arial") +
    theme(
      axis.title.x       = element_text(size = base_pt, color = "black"),
      axis.text.x        = element_text(size = base_pt, color = "black"),
      axis.text.y        = element_text(size = base_pt, color = "black", face = "bold"),
      axis.line          = element_line(linewidth = 0.3, color = "black"),
      axis.ticks         = element_line(linewidth = 0.3, color = "black"),
      strip.text         = element_text(size = base_pt, family = "Arial",   
                                        color = "black", lineheight = 0.85,
                                        face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "gray90", linetype = "dotted",
                                        linewidth = 0.3),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
      panel.spacing      = unit(3, "pt"),
      legend.position    = "none",
      plot.background    = element_blank(),
      plot.margin        = margin(4, 6, 2, 4, "pt"),
      panel.clip         = "off"
    )
}


legend_df <- data.frame(
  g = factor(group_order, levels = group_order),
  x = seq_along(group_order),
  y = 1
)

legend_only_plot <- ggplot(legend_df, aes(x = x, y = y, color = g)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = group_colors,
    labels = unname(group_labels[group_order]),
    breaks = group_order
  ) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(
      nrow         = 1,
      keywidth     = unit(10, "pt"),   
      keyheight    = unit(8,  "pt"),
      label.hjust  = 0,                
      byrow        = TRUE,
      override.aes = list(size = 3)
    )
  ) +
  labs(color = NULL) +
  theme(
    line              = element_blank(),
    rect              = element_blank(),
    text              = element_blank(),
    axis.text         = element_blank(),
    axis.title        = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks        = element_blank(),
    axis.line         = element_blank(),
    panel.background  = element_blank(),
    panel.border      = element_blank(),
    panel.grid        = element_blank(),
    plot.background   = element_blank(),
    plot.margin       = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    legend.position   = "bottom",
    legend.direction  = "horizontal",
    legend.text       = element_text(size = 7, family = "Arial",
                                     color = "black",
                                     margin = margin(r = 12, l = 2, unit = "pt")), 
    legend.key        = element_blank(),
    legend.key.size   = unit(8,  "pt"),
    legend.spacing.x  = unit(2,  "pt"),   
    legend.margin     = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    legend.background = element_blank()
  )

shared_legend <- get_legend(legend_only_plot)


p1 <- plot_forest(df_cn)
p2 <- plot_forest(df_agent)

combined_plot <- (p1 / p2) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1)) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a") &
  theme(
    plot.background   = element_blank(),
    plot.tag          = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold",
                                     family = "Arial", color = "black"),
    plot.tag.position = "topleft"
  )

fig_width_in  <- 183 / 25.4
fig_height_in <- 150 / 25.4

final_plot <- ggdraw(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  draw_plot(combined_plot, x = 0, y = 0.07, width = 1, height = 0.93) +
  draw_plot(shared_legend, x = 0, y = 0,    width = 1, height = 0.07)


ggsave(
  "forest_plot.png",
  plot   = final_plot,
  width  = fig_width_in,
  height = fig_height_in,
  dpi    = 600,
  units  = "in"
)

ggsave(
  "forest_plot.pdf",
  plot   = final_plot,
  width  = fig_width_in,
  height = fig_height_in,
  device = cairo_pdf,
  units  = "in"
)

cat("Saved：forest_plot.png / .pdf\n")
```
